title: Exact fraction quantity promotion

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
Stable human-readable promotion rank and progress authority.
Accepted platform milestone placement and deferrals.
Exact arithmetic quantity rationale and four-view requirements.

expectedLearning: Whether exact partition refinement and contributor lineage can synchronize symbolic and concrete views without representation-owned math.
Whether existing canonical motion, clock, layout, host, Review, and promotion seams amortize a new multi-view exemplar without new runtime categories.
Whether typed completeness and evidence-derived promotion prevent missing views, identity fades, and false ported status.
allowedWork: One exact rational quantity, unit, partition, selection, and provenance model.
One verified five-beat trace with immutable evaluation and four synchronized view projections.
Existing canonical animation, correspondence, clock, reader, responsive, static, accessibility, export, Animation Library, Review, and promotion seams.
Bounded generic contracts proven necessary by the exemplar and stable repository-owned checks.
disallowedWork: No second renderer session, compositor, runtime, clock, scheduler, paint authority, display page, or WebGL lease.
No renderer-owned arithmetic, representation-specific semantic exception, glyph inference, or whole-scene fade replacement.
No fraction-family rollout, later promotions, problem-generator bridge, LLM editorial integration, universal motif registry, or detached cleanup.
No overwrite of unrelated user-owned dirty files.
goal: Promote one canonical exact-quantity animation for 1/3 + 1/6 = 1/2 across native KaTeX, partitioned circles, fraction bars or area, and a number line, stopping for human visual review before release.
commitCadence: Commit after each completed and proportionately verified slice; keep control, semantic, projection, product, checkpoint, repair, and release rollback units independently revertible.
stopConditions: Stop if exact value, unit identity, selected-part provenance, contributor lineage, fold truth, accessibility, export truth, or settled native authority changes.
Stop if a visual projection becomes mathematical authority or persistent, fission, or fusion identity falls back to generic opacity.
Stop if implementation requires a new clock, runtime, scheduler category, equation compositor, WebGL lease, display page, or representation-specific semantic exception.
Stop if a certificate can be forged, a required view can be omitted, promotion can be claimed by an authorable flag, or another canonical reader regresses.
Stop at slice 23 for explicit human visual approval before slices 24 and 25.
Stop if unrelated user-owned dirty files must be overwritten.

slices.title: materialize-approved-contract
slices.summary: Materialized the approved contract and linked the active exact-fraction promotion phase to its execution authority.

slices.title: reconcile-stale-frontier
slices.summary: Activated warning-free plan revision 13. Reconciled the never-executed duplicate convergence scaffold as skipped history, linked completed radical and quadratic evidence to their terminal authorities, linked this run to exact-fraction-quantity-models, and preserved the stable content-led promotion order plus platform gates.

slices.title: add-promotion-drift-gate
slices.summary: Added a repository-owned promotion-memory gate that parses the sole stable ledger, derives the first unresolved rank, checks the roadmap and current queue, requires one matching active Theseus phase and live run, and makes a promoted claim fail unless its catalog animation ID is evidence-derived as ported. Updated the living pointers to the active exact-fraction run without duplicating the rank table.

slices.title: freeze-exemplar-reference
slices.summary: Froze the exact 1/3 + 1/6 = 1/2 reference as five ordered checkpoints and pacing beats over one shared unit and six stable atomic parts. Required symbolic, circle, bar, and number-line views; preserved fold, accessibility, and architecture truth; and explicitly forbade renderer arithmetic, geometry/DOM/color identity, opacity handoffs, new display pages, runtime categories, and resource growth.

slices.title: add-exact-quantity-core
slices.summary: Extracted the linear provider's bigint rational laws into one immutable domain-neutral core while leaving DTO and solver policy in the provider. Added nominal exact-quantity units and a proof-carrying sum constructor: NoInfer rejects authored cross-unit addition at typecheck, and an explicit runtime identity guard rejects widened or decoded mismatches before a certificate can exist.

slices.title: model-finite-partitions
slices.summary: Added a geometry-free finite-partition domain model with exact positive measures totaling one, deterministic branded part IDs, contiguous logical ordinals, immutable partition-scoped selections, and exact derived quantities. Duplicate IDs, ordinal gaps, bad totals, repeated selections, missing parts, and cross-partition authored IDs all fail before projection.

slices.title: certify-refine-and-merge
slices.summary: Added module-sealed certificates for whole-partition refinement, selected refinement, disjoint selection fusion, and equivalent regrouping. Every cohort proves exact measure and exhaustive non-duplicated source/target lineage, classifies persist/fission/fusion/regroup, supports inverse regrouping, and rejects incomplete, overlapping, mismatched, or structurally forged witnesses.
